canonicalBusiness.publicationBasis: Existing repository identity plus public registry corroboration; address and VAT ID remain unpublished until owner-verified.

principles: No PII in analytics events, logs, URLs, experiment cookies or alert payloads.
Mail delivery state and commercial handling state are separate authorities.
A read email never marks a lead handled; workflow transitions are explicit server mutations.
No public custom-domain route may render the operations dashboard or customer PII.
Provider credentials are server-only and every provider remains disabled when configuration is incomplete.
Every mutation is idempotent, revision-bound and auditable.
No client-supplied price, role, owner, delivery state or experiment conversion is authoritative.

leadProjection.piiBoundary: Only the SSO-protected operations surface may receive name, email, phone, organisation, notes or stored documents.

publicBooking.semantics: preferred scan request, pending human confirmation
publicBooking.success: Durable booking lead plus exactly two durable transactional outbox jobs accepted atomically.
publicBooking.failure: No success UI, calendar-confirmation claim or receipt when durable acceptance fails.

publicQuote.success: Server-recomputed quote, durable lead, PDF and exactly two durable transactional outbox jobs accepted atomically.
publicQuote.failure: No PDF or receipt when prepare or commit fails.

experiments.assignment: First-party SameSite=Lax cookie containing only experiment ID, variant and schema version; no user identifier.

operationsSurface.requiredOuterControl: Vercel Authentication/SSO enabled and provider-read-back before release

customerCaseRule: customer_case is forbidden without recorded customer approval and claim evidence
ownerGates: Supabase target selection and additive production migration
Microsoft Graph application permission and mailbox restriction
Search Console and Bing ownership verification
Publication of address, VAT ID, customer names, testimonials or measured outcomes
